population: all225, same51 islands and1275 pairs as island_host_network
primary_unit: butterfly species recorded new in both islands of a pair
matching: intersection of alien candidate plants recorded at both island ports with accepted host list for focal butterfly
outputs: fraction of shared-new species-pair records with >=1 matching shared plant; species-equal fraction; named plants ranked by distinct butterfly species then pairs
comparison: among pairs with focal butterfly new in at least one island, within-species descriptive phi association between new in both and matching shared host; >=5 pairs and both variables varying
limits: This is catalogue compatibility, not observed feeding, transport, establishment or temporally valid prediction. Species-pair entries are dependent. No p-values, causal claim or inference from lack of matching record. Plant-specific rankings overlap and cannot be summed.
